body.label: Target
body.html: One detected enemy within ranged Weapon Range behind light, non-solid cover.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Ignore up to 2 points of ordinary cover bonus. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Solid walls still block the shot.

surges.html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude for this attack.
One hit target cannot claim that particular cover source until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: After a hit, you may end Lock to let the next allied ranged attack against that target ignore 1 point of cover bonus until the start of your next turn.
